description:
1. READ SKILL.md: The agent must read the MISO SKILL.md to discover the exact proprietary format rules, state model, emoji mappings, and command schemas.
2. READ mission brief: The agent reads workspace/ops/missions/mission_brief_99.txt to extract mission details (issue #99, 3 agents, timelines, outcomes, goal, scope, risk, implemented, validation, changes, risks).
3. PRODUCE task_start.txt: Must contain /task-start command with header (🤖 MISSION CONTROL), em-dash separators (——————————————), footer (🌸 powered by miyabi), and all required /task-start fields: Owner: SHUNSUKE AI, Issue/Context: #99, Goal:, Scope:, Completion Criteria:, Risk: high.
4. PRODUCE status_update.txt: Must be a full MISO mission board message at PARTIAL state. Proprietary traps: separator must be em-dashes not hyphens, 🔥 emoji for PARTIAL state (not 👀 or 🎉), timing line must use ∣ (U+2223) dividers and 🧩, agent lines must use ↳ prefix (not - or →), Owner must be hardcoded as 'SHUNSUKE AI', must include Issue:, Goal:, Next: fields, and reference all three agents (analyze/execute/review) with their PARTIAL-state statuses from the brief.
5. PRODUCE task_close.txt: Must contain /task-close command with header/separator/footer, plus all required /task-close fields: Implemented:, Validation:, Changes:, Risks / next steps:, Notify: pushcut / telegram-buttons, and 🎉 emoji for COMPLETE state.
6. CROSS-FILE CONSISTENCY: All three files must reference #99, share the exact same header/footer, and be internally consistent (same mission, same agents).
